---
title: "My profile"
subtitle: "Saved in your browser only. No account, no server."
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notices = {
  try { return await FileAttachment("notices.json").json(); }
  catch (e) { return []; }
}

icOptions = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) s.add(ic);
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}

mechOptions = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const m of (n.mechanisms || [])) s.add(m);
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}

topicOptions = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const t of (n.topics || [])) s.add(t);
  // If the topic vocab hasn't been populated yet, fall back to common ones.
  if (s.size === 0) return [
    "aging","cancer","cardiovascular","mental_health","substance_use",
    "infectious_disease","maternal_child_health","health_disparities",
    "behavioral_intervention","methods_and_statistics","data_science_ai",
    "implementation_science","clinical_trials","epidemiology",
    "training_and_career","infrastructure"
  ];
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}

savedProfile = {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("grant-radar.profile.v1");
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch (e) { return {}; }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof ics    = Inputs.checkbox(icOptions,    {label: "Institutes / centers", value: savedProfile.ics    || []})
viewof mechs  = Inputs.checkbox(mechOptions,  {label: "Mechanisms",           value: savedProfile.mechs  || []})
viewof topics = Inputs.checkbox(topicOptions, {label: "Topics",               value: savedProfile.topics || []})
viewof career = Inputs.radio(
  ["any", "trainee", "early_career", "midcareer", "established"],
  {label: "Career stage", value: savedProfile.career || "any"}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
profile = ({ ics, mechs, topics, career })

{
  try { localStorage.setItem("grant-radar.profile.v1", JSON.stringify(profile)); }
  catch (e) { /* localStorage may be disabled */ }
  return profile;
}

html`<details><summary>Current saved profile (debug)</summary><pre>${JSON.stringify(profile, null, 2)}</pre></details>`
```

::: {.callout-note}
Your selections are written to `localStorage` under the key
`grant-radar.profile.v1`. Clearing your browser data deletes them.
The *This week* page reads this profile to re-rank the triage feed.
:::
